stem: In which sentence or phrase from the selection does the author’s use of language best convey a sentimental mood?

options.label: A
options.text: I spent most of the summertime outside, running through freshly laundered clothes (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: I would smile to myself, trying to imagine her as a young girl (paragraph 3)

options.label: C
options.text: In that moment, I was no longer alone. (paragraph 6)

options.label: D
options.text: I hope my grandmother knows how much those moments meant to me. (paragraph 7)
